sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.5.1 "Double VLAN processing" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2153.
sections.section_content:
The Ethernet peripheral supports the double VLAN (Virtual LAN) tagging feature in which
the MAC can process up to two VLAN tags (inner and outer).
The MAC supports the following:
• Insertion, replacement, or deletion of up to two VLAN tags in the Transmit path
• Packet filtering and stripping based on any one of the two VLAN Tags in the receive
path. Stripping and providing up to two VLAN Tags in the receive path as a part of the
receive status
